title: プール縁用の曲線手すり付き入水はしご
titleEn: Pool-entry ladder with curved deck grab rails
description: プールの縁に取り付ける入水用はしごの静的プロップ。左右の連続した曲線手すり、深さ方向へ延びる四段の踏み板と滑り止め形状、デッキ固定ソケット、下部の壁当てパッドを造形しています。デッキ面は最下点から約1.27 m上に合わせて配置してください。水面・プール壁・床は付属せず、保守用ケージはしごとは別の構成です。昇降機能、耐荷重、滑り抵抗や安全認証を示すモデルではありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.772 × 2.213 × 0.806 m、7,656三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A static pool-entry ladder for the edge of a swimming pool, with two continuous curved deck grab rails, four immersed-run treads with raised traction detail, deck sockets and lower wall-contact pads. Position the deck about 1.27 m above the lowest point of this grounded asset. Water, pool wall and deck are omitted; this is not a caged maintenance ladder. No climbing function, load rating, slip-resistance performance or safety certification is supplied. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.772 × 2.213 × 0.806 m; 7,656 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
